symptom: Generated connect or protobuf code does not match the .proto, or gen/ will not compile.
cause: A .proto was edited without re-running buf generate, so gen/ is stale. Or paths=source_relative is missing and the output landed in the wrong directory.
steps: Re-run buf generate from the module root.
Check buf.gen.yaml sets paths=source_relative; without it the generated files nest under a full module path and nothing imports them.
Do not hand-edit anything under gen/. It is regenerated wholesale.
Run go_build after generating; a stale import is the usual leftover.
watch_out: This applies only to the connect variant, not to default-n-api services.
